name: Dundalk Leisurecraft CT Elation Barrel Sauna Canadian Timber 4 Person | CTC2424W
description: Description Escape into the warmth and serenity of nature with the CT Elation Sauna, a luxurious outdoor retreat crafted from premium eastern white cedar. Designed for maximum comfort and style, this spacious sauna features extra-wide 23” benches, a tall 7’4” profile, and a solid flat floor — perfect for unwinding solo or with friends. With its all-in-one design that includes a porch, windows, and benches, setup is simple: just choose your preferred heater and optional add-ons to complete your wellness oasis. Features Premium Eastern White Cedar: Naturally resistant to decay and beautiful in any outdoor setting Spacious 7'4" Height: Accommodates tall users comfortably Extra-Wide 23” Benches: Generously sized seating for maximum relaxation 5mm Bronze Tempered Glass: Durable, stylish door and windows for natural light and visibility Triple Layer Roof: Includes ice & water shield plus beveled cedar for durability and insulation Solid Flat Bottom: Enhanced comfort and a stable foundation All-in-One Package: Includes porch, benches, and windows — just add a heater Customizable Heating: Choose from wood-burning or electric heater options Easy DIY Setup: Comes as a kit for straightforward assembly What's Included? Pre-cut eastern white cedar panels and components Solid flat wood floor Porch with front overhang 23" wide cedar benches (interior) 5mm bronze tempered glass door and front windows Triple-layer roofing system (ice/water shield + cedar bevel roof) Hardware and assembly instructions Optional Add-Ons Wood-burning heater with chimney kit Electric sauna heater with digital controls Interior LED lighting kit Backrests and comfort accessories Specifications External Dimensions: 88" H 98" W 96" D Material: Eastern White Cedar Seating Capacity: 4 people Glass: 5mm bronze tempered glass Roof: Triple-layer (ice/water shield + cedar bevel) Weight: 1,496.5 lbs (gross) Shipping Dimensions: 96” L x 45” W x 44” H Assembly Elation Barrel Sauna Assembly Instructions
